svg.title: RES and battery switch-over. Step 4: the monitoring system (voltage divider to A0)
svg.text: Step 4: the monitoring system (voltage divider to A0)
load: LED + 220 Ω (stands in for the pump)
Divider across the RES: R1 from RES + to strip 24, R2 from strip 24 to ground; strip 24 (the mid-point) goes to A0.
A short wire joins the top − rail to the bottom − rail.
